stat.title: Jamie Benn needs one more for 1,000
lines: He has played every one of his NHL games for Dallas, and has seven points in 17 this season.
Our numbers give him a 38% chance to get there tonight against Winnipeg.

2026020299.title: Two hot goalies, one old rivalry
2026020299.dek: Montreal has points in 11 straight. Boston has won four in a row. Neither has needed many goals.
threads: Jacob Fowler has saved 12.1 goals more than expected. Jeremy Swayman is at 10.2.
Boston's record outruns its chances: a +26 goal difference on chances worth about +1.
Mike Matheson could return for Montreal. Ivan Demidov is still out.

2026020300.title: The Wild walk into a Leafs referendum
2026020300.dek: Minnesota has points in nine straight. Toronto is winless in four and starts its backup.
threads: The Leafs' slide is real: outscored 17-7 on 42% of the chances.
Jesper Wallstedt leads the league at 16.0 goals saved above expected.
Kirill Kaprizov has points in nine straight and is tonight's likeliest scorer at 49%.

2026020301.title: Two goalies, opposite directions
2026020301.dek: Colorado rests Mackenzie Blackwood. Scott Wedgewood has been 5.4 goals worse than expected.
threads: Linus Ullmark is at +8.2 for Ottawa.
The Avalanche have scored about 13 more goals than their chances usually produce.
Devon Toews has 11 points in his last ten games, and the chances back it.

2026020303.title: Hellebuyck in Newark
2026020303.dek: Connor Hellebuyck gets the Devils' net two nights after his return to Winnipeg ended their five-game run.
threads: New Jersey takes 58% of the expected goals, among the best in the league.
Washington won the first meeting 4-2, though the Devils deserved it in 73% of replays.
Jack Hughes has points in six straight and 22 shots in his last five.

2026020304.title: Tampa, the morning after eight
2026020304.dek: The Lightning scored eight in Buffalo last night. Tonight they play again, with their backup in net.
threads: Dennis Hildeby starts over Andrei Vasilevskiy on the second night of a back-to-back.
Brayden Point is still out. Jake Guentzel plays his 700th game.
Matthew Knies has no goals in ten games, and the chances have dried up too.

2026020302.title: Still no Larkin
2026020302.dek: Detroit is winless in four and the standoff with its captain drags on.
threads: The Red Wings' slide is real: outscored 13-5 on 43% of the chances.
John Gibson has an .856 save rate over his last five starts.
Florida is without Barkov and Marchand. Sam Reinhart is two points from 700.

2026020305.title: Chicago's bottom, Buffalo's tired legs
2026020305.dek: The Blackhawks are winless in six. The Sabres gave up eight at home last night.
threads: Chicago has been outscored 32-13 in the skid, on 36% of the chances.
Buffalo starts backup Colten Ellis on the second night of a back-to-back.
Patrick Kane could be back for Chicago.

2026020306.title: Benn at 999
2026020306.dek: Jamie Benn is one point from 1,000, all of them in a Stars sweater.
threads: Winnipeg has won four straight and earned it: 62% of the expected goals.
Dallas is without Miro Heiskanen. Jake Oettinger is at +7.7 this season.
The Stars won the first meeting 3-2 in overtime, and deserved it.

2026020307.title: Utah's best process, worst goaltending
2026020307.dek: The Mammoth win the chances most nights. Their goalies have given back about 12 goals.
threads: Karel Vejmelka has an .847 save rate over his last five starts.
Utah is without Logan Cooley and Dylan Guenther, and played in Vegas last night.
Joel Hofer has saved 6.7 goals more than expected for St. Louis.

2026020308.title: Sorokin, standing on his head
2026020308.dek: Ilya Sorokin keeps saving the Islanders. They're winless in four anyway.
threads: Sorokin is at +8.2 goals saved above expected.
New York has been outscored 17-9 in the skid, on 43% of the chances.
Darcy Kuemper plays his 500th game. Corey Perry, 41, has eight shots from dangerous ice in ten games.
